Avalon Sword Dancer
Some elves chose to return to Avalon to serve the Everqueen. Those who wield spears form the ranks of the Avalon Sword Dancers.
The Everqueen's handmaidens wield double-bladed spears, becoming Avalon's elite spearwomen.
Avalon Blade Singer
Some elves chose to return to Avalon to serve the Everqueen. Those who wield twin blades form the ranks of the Avalon Sword Dancers.
The Everqueen's handmaidens wield twin blades, fighting on the battlefield like valkyries.

Valiant Archers
Veterans of countless elven wars, disillusioned with the elves of today, yet they continue to hone their skills with the weapons in their hands through every trial.
Valiant Archers, dispatched by Tyrion to fight in the most desperate of battles, their extraordinary marksmanship makes them unstoppable.
Valiant Swordsmen
Veterans of countless elven wars, disillusioned with the elves of today, yet they continue to hone their skills with the weapons in their hands through every trial.
They are the damage dealers of the Valiant legions, skilled at striking down all manner of enemies, whether heavily or lightly armored.
Valiant Guardians
Veterans of countless elven wars, disillusioned with the elves of today, yet they continue to hone their skills with the weapons in their hands through every trial.
The Valiant Guardians are the protective deities of the legion, standing at the most perilous points of the battlefield, their shield wall impenetrable to both ranged fire and melee assault.
